mapper.select: SELECT po.po_no AS poNo, po.branch_code AS branchCode, b.name AS branchName, b.region_code AS regionCode, r.name AS regionName, po.request_date AS requestDate, po.total_amount AS totalAmount, po.total_material_cnt AS totalMaterialCnt FROM place_order po JOIN branch b ON po.branch_code = b.branch_code JOIN region r ON b.region_code = r.region_code WHERE po.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY po.request_date ASC;

SELECT m.material_name as materialName, pod.requested_qty as requestedQty, pod.approved_qty as approvedQty, m.unit FROM place_order_detail pod JOIN material m ON pod.material_code = m.material_code JOIN place_order po ON pod.po_id = po.po_id WHERE po.po_no = #{poNo};
SELECT d.driver_id AS driverId, e.name, e.phone FROM driver d JOIN employee e ON d.emp_no = e.emp_no WHERE d.is_active = TRUE AND d.region_code = #{regionCode};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispatch (po_no, driver_id, vehicle_id, status) VALUES (#{poNo}, #{driverId}, #{vehicleId}, 'IN_TRANSIT');
mapper.update: UPDATE place_order SET status = #{status} WHERE po_no = #{poNo};
UPDATE vehicle SET status = #{status} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId};
mapper.select: SELECT region_code as regionCode, name FROM region ORDER BY name;

SELECT d.delivery_id AS deliveryId, d.po_no AS poNo, b.name AS branchName, e.name AS driverName, v.plate_number AS vehiclePlate, d.status AS dispatchStatus, po.status AS placeOrderStatus, po.request_date AS requestDate FROM dispatch d JOIN place_order po ON d.po_no = po.po_no JOIN branch b ON po.branch_code = b.branch_code LEFT JOIN driver dr ON d.driver_id = dr.driver_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON dr.emp_no = e.emp_no LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON d.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id ORDER BY d.delivery_id DESC;
